description: Mystere IVA c/n 334 (Bharat Rakshak) displayed in an open lot at the Rajya Sainik Board opposite Tis Hazari courts since about 1988; refurbished and repainted in 2015 with intake faired over, so the info board wrongly calls it an Ouragan (WBI, Sept 2015). Coordinates from WBI map fix.
museum_name: Rajya Sainik Board Tis Hazari Mystere
